# Triage labels

<!-- GENERATED by `mario-agentops fleet sync-policy` from ~/.agent-config/manifests/fleet.json. Do not edit by hand. Change the manifest or the template in mario-agentops, then, from a worktree of this repo, run `mario-agentops fleet sync-policy --apply --repo cre-skills-plugin --dir cre-skills-plugin=<worktree>`. -->

The skills speak in seven canonical triage roles: five states and two categories. This file maps each role to a label of the Linear team **CRE Skills** (`CRE`) for `cre-skills-plugin`.

## State roles

| Role (mattpocock/skills) | Label in Linear | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `needs-triage` | `needs-triage` | Maintainer needs to evaluate this issue |
| `needs-info` | `needs-info` | Waiting on reporter for more information |
| `ready-for-agent` | `ready-for-agent` | Fully specified, ready for an AFK agent |
| `ready-for-human` | `ready-for-human` | Requires human implementation |
| `wontfix` | `wontfix` | Will not be actioned |

## Category roles

| Role (mattpocock/skills) | Label in Linear | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `bug` | `Bug` | Something is broken |
| `enhancement` | `Feature` or `Improvement` | A new feature (`Feature`) or a change to existing behavior (`Improvement`) |

These three labels are workspace labels that Linear provides to every team.

## How to apply them

- When a skill names a role (for example, "apply the AFK-ready triage label"), use the label in the second column.
- Give a triaged issue one category label and one state label. A new issue that `to-spec` or `to-tickets` publishes needs only the state label.
- A label does not replace the Linear state. The issue keeps its state (`Backlog`, `Todo`, and so on) while it holds a label.
- A `wontfix` issue also moves to the `Canceled` state of the team.
- If a state label is missing in the team, create it with `save_issue_label`. Never rename a label that already exists.
